title: acer paxii var. ningpoense
intro: Acer paxii var. ningpoense, commonly known as Ningpo Maple, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the family Sapindaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and pneumonia, making it a valuable herbal remedy. The therapeutic actions of Ningpo Maple include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant effects, which help to alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
